_about: Company to assessment-format mapping, so that '/sim <company>' launches the
right shape. JSON rather than YAML because the engine is stdlib only and
PyYAML is not a dependency this project is willing to take on. Presets are
flat scalars, so nothing is lost.
Every entry MUST carry sources, confidence, and last_confirmed. tools/qa.py
rejects entries that do not, and CI runs it. This is deliberate: a preset is
a factual claim about what a company currently does, and an unsourced one is
a guess wearing a fact's clothing.
high    multiple independent recent reports, or the company says so publicly
medium  reported, but thinly or not recently
Formats change every hiring cycle. The skill says the confidence out loud and
reminds the user that their actual invite email names the platform.

_entry_template.questions: number of questions, or levels for ica
_entry_template.flavor: one line on the reported style, or null
